# Muzluk agent question UI

Use @muzluk/agent-questions to render validated agent follow-up questions in React.
Use @muzluk/mood-wheel when only the tactile five-stop mood control is needed.

Primary docs:
- README.md
- docs/api.md
- docs/agent-integration.md
- AGENTS.md

Important invariants:
- Stable values are separate from translated labels.
- Parse unknown agent output before rendering.
- Consumers own persistence, authentication, model calls, and transcription.
- The packages are React web packages; no Expo/native code is included.
